ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This section is for the participants of the Champaign County Summer Ag Institute on using Math, Science and Reading to teach about alternative energy and renewable resources from July 17 to July 20th, 2007. Students may elect to register for 2 or 3 credit hours. Students will participate in 2 projects for 2 graduate credits and 3 projects for 3 graduate credits.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
